subject: engineering-simplicity
scenario: A principle that lives only in prose is advice. Simplicity by default is a first-class capability only if the rule, the triggers that demand a justification, and what counts as evidence are machine-readable and reachable by the same checker that reads every other contract.
expected_behaviors: policies/simplicity-policy.json states the principle and enumerates the complexity triggers.
The three evidence kinds are named, and the non-evidence list rules out unquantified growth.
The skill exists and is the prose half of the same rule.
failure_conditions: The principle exists only as documentation, so nothing can check whether it was applied.
The trigger list is empty, so no introduction ever requires a justification.

checks.description: The machine-readable half of the principle.
Splitting one deployable into several is a trigger, not a default.
A justification that never names the alternative is not a comparison.
Rejecting the simpler option requires naming what it fails.

checks.pattern: Unquantified growth is not a requirement
checks.description: 'We might need to scale' is explicitly not evidence.
